payload.summary: Keep packaged README relative references aligned with the npm files whitelist and package checks.
lessons: When a PR adds a repository-relative README link or image that npm consumers can see, update package.json files and scripts/check-package.ts so the packed tarball contains the target.
If the linked document contains its own repository-relative references, either include those targets as well or avoid making the package README point at the document.
Run bun run check:package after merging documentation or package-whitelist PRs into branches that add README links; earlier green package checks may become stale after branch stacking.
verification: Inspect npm pack metadata for every repository-relative README reference.
Keep scripts/check-package.ts expected packageJson.files, requiredFiles, and allowedFiles in sync with package.json files.
